verdict.rationale: Loops documents transactional email as its own send type for receipts, password resets and login codes, with a dedicated POST /transactional endpoint that takes data variables, and sends it alongside marketing and product email. That supports the core idea of a distinct transactional channel, but the evidence describes "one API, one contact model" and never says that transactional suppression or reputation is kept apart from marketing. Missing for 10: evidence that transactional sends ignore marketing unsubscribes (a receipt reaching an unsubscribed contact), separate suppression rules, separate sending reputation (IP or domain), explicitly separate template management, and any independent corroboration.
